territorial_scope.description: Amends the Federal Criminal Code and the Federal Copyright Law, federal statutes applying nationwide in Mexico; no extraterritorial reach is stated.

evidence.quote: Se reforman el Título Noveno, el Capítulo III del mismo

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Bill adding to the Federal Criminal Code definitions of generative AI tools and a misuse offence (6 months to 4 years' prison, 100 to 600 days' fine), and amending the Federal Copyright Law on AI-assisted works. Introduced 30 April 2025; would apply from the day after publication.
summary.long: Bill presented to the Chamber of Deputies on 30 April 2025 by PAN deputies, referred to joint committees on Justice and Science and Technology. It would add to the Federal Criminal Code a definition of generative AI tools (high autonomy, content such as text, images, audio, video or code created from deep learning models in response to commands) and an offence of their misuse: deceptive non-consensual manipulation of images or recordings passed as real; tools fed with non-selectively extracted facial or private data, unlawful remote biometric identification, or falsification of official documents; dissemination of confidential information or illegally obtained images; and generating works presented as one's own for commercial registration, infringing protected works or constituting fraud. Such conduct would carry six months to four years' imprisonment and 100 to 600 days' fine. The Federal Copyright Law would classify works by the technology used, exclude from protection autonomously generated AI content that infringes existing rights, lacks authorization for its inputs and does not disclose sources, technology or authors, and extend the computer-program definition to AI-assisted systems. Entry into force the day after publication in the Diario Oficial de la Federación. The text names no enforcement authority.

thresholds.note: The bill has no numeric cutoff that changes legal treatment of a person or entity. The prison term (6 months to 4 years) and fine range (100 to 600 días multa) in Art. 211 Bis 10 are penalty ranges, recorded under enforcement, not thresholds. The bill contains no size, value, usage or scope cutoffs; the generative AI tool definition in Art. 211 Bis 8 has no numeric element.
